observed_errors: forbidden public-paper token found in manuscript, bibliography, or figure source
evidence receipt or locator identity mismatch
context graph identity, topology, authority, projection, or outcome-state mismatch
submission artifact is not reproducible from its committed builder
legacy_gate.scope: combined paper-release snapshot gate; remains NOT PASS and is not retired for manuscript/submission release

observed_context_graph.note: moving worktree diagnostic only; not immutable current validation

rationale: An append-only research graph cannot treat predecessor exact node/edge counts and projection-key set as current authority.
The legacy gate also binds protected/concurrently-owned manuscript and release artifacts that this lane must not rewrite.
Passing the active graph does not imply the paper release gate passes.

current_active_graph_gates.role: closed relation vocabulary and predecessor semantics
canonical 13/13 handoff, current authority hashes, scope/cardinality consistency
all graph IDs/endpoints and every projection path/hash pair without frozen cardinality

authority_limit: This decision governs active research-graph continuation only. It does not waive manuscript, evidence, submission artifact, form, or release validation.
pass_rule: All three current validators and their failing-first fixtures pass against immutable committed bytes in a clean clone.
prohibited_claim: Do not report the monolithic .orx paper release validator as PASS.
